entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon spoke to business leaders on Thursday morning at the China Business Summit in Auckland | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Discussions at the conference are expected to focus on New Zealand's relationship with the Asian nation as well as the global fuel crisis.

Luxon also held a Q&A session at the event.

Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/620488/watch-live-christopher-luxon-faces-questions-at-china-business-summit
